name: Gisa
description: Gisa Cecani is a necromancer and ghoulcaller from Innistrad, twin sister and rival of Geralf, known for raising the dead by whistling.

description_citations.text: "Gisa Cecani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

summary.text: Gisa Cecani is a necromancer and ghoulcaller from Innistrad, twin sister and rival of Geralf, known for raising the dead by whistling.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

bio.text: Gisa and Geralf were banished from Thraben in a scandal and moved to the Moorland, where they waged war on each other with undead armies.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Geralf Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Geralf started the siege of Thraben and invited her along, but Gisa abandoned it after being pushed back by fire, and Odric captured her and imprisoned her in Rider's Lock.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Geralf sent skaabs to free her, and she befriended Nahiri and raised ghoul builders for the Drownyard Temple.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Gisa Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

bio.text: After the Eldrazi invasion she took control of Liliana's abandoned zombie army and made Thraben her own, easily defeating her suitor Wilhelt's army.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Gisa Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She took over the Engelturm after being forced out of Geralf's lab, and the siblings joined forces to defeat the Phyrexian invasion of Innistrad before returning to their rivalry.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Gisa Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She and Geralf then travelled to Thunder Junction and joined Oko's crew, where her early zombie raising complicated the train job.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: At Thief's Folly she triggered a trap and, with Stella Lee's help, she and Geralf secured the map.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: Gisa is alive, and after the crew's breakup she offered to team up with Oko again, while the most recent card text shows her delighting in raising the dead.

citations.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
Foundations Commander: card flavor text (Foundations Commander, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Siblings Gisa and Geralf, banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal, moved to the Moorland and war against each other with undead armies.
timeline.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and have since moved to the Moorland

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Geralf overran the village of Trostad with his undead while Gisa besieges it, and he raids Nearheath villages.
timeline.quote: which has been entirely overrun by Geralf and his undead creations.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The twins are banished from Thraben and wage undead war against each other in the Moorland.
timeline.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and then moved to the Moorland

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf takes over Trostad and Gisa attacks it, starting NecroWarfare.
timeline.quote: Geralf took over Trostad, most likely massacring the inhabitants who didn't flee.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sets up the siege of Thraben, sneaks in to kill Mikaeus, and meets Liliana who brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odric captures Gisa and Liliana causes the sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Shortly thereafter, Liliana caused the sundering of the Helvault .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, then busies himself with his masterpiece under Ludevic.
timeline.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cecani twins are banished from Thraben in a scandal and move to the Moorland, where they wage war with undead armies.
timeline.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and moved to the Moorland

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf takes over Trostad and Gisa attacks it just to best her brother, starting NecroWarfare.
timeline.quote: Gisa attacked Trostad simply to best her brother, starting what they called "NecroWarfare".

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf tries to set formal rules for the war, which Gisa ignores.
timeline.quote: Geralf had tried to set formal rules, named The Five Laws of NecroWarfare :

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf starts the siege of Thraben and invites Gisa along, ending their engagement; he sneaks into the city to kill Mikaeus.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa abandons the siege after being pushed back by fire, and Odric captures her and imprisons her in Rider's Lock.
timeline.quote: Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, who says she did not need his help; she retreats to her parents' manor and revives them as zombies.
timeline.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa befriends Nahiri and provides ghouls to build the Drownyard temple.
timeline.quote: She found a new friend in the lithomancer Nahiri and provided the ghouls to build the Drownyard temple.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf kills Mikaeus the Lunarch during the Siege of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Geralf killed Mikaeus the Lunarch

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa throws bones at her brother Geralf, calling to him.
timeline.quote: Here are some bones for you to choke on, dear brother!

citation.text: Farbog Boneflinger (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gisa refuses the Blessed Sleep and wakes the dead to work.
timeline.quote: Wake up my lovelies, there's work to be done!

citation.text: Gravepurge (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben; Mikaeus appoints Thalia supreme commander after Luthor is found dead.
timeline.quote: he appointed Thalia as the supreme commander of the city's forces

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Avacyn's absence, Gisa and Geralf besiege Thraben; Geralf kills Lunarch Mikaeus and Liliana raises him as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Lunarch Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa's army breaks the outer wall but is pushed back by fire; Odric captures Gisa.
timeline.quote: Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben with ghouls and skaabs.
timeline.quote: They besieged the city of Thraben with their ghoulish army

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus is killed in the assault and entombed in secret beneath the cathedral.
timeline.quote: So Mikaeus was entombed in secret, whisked away to the clandestine catacombs beneath the cathedral.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's cryptoliths, powered by Innistrad's leylines, summon Emrakul and drive many angels, including Avacyn, mad.
timeline.quote: These cryptholiths also caused multiple angels

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, builds cryptoliths and the Drownyard Temple, and summons Emrakul to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
timeline.quote: "Triple the escort," Odric said.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Gisa tells Geralf she agreed to nothing and will raise ghouls whenever she wishes.
timeline.quote: I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish.

citation.text: Ghoulcaller Gisa (Commander 2014, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa briefly set aside their differences to join Liliana against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to join her and team up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf briefly team up against the Eldrazi that invaded Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to team up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grete's prison caravan carrying Gisa is attacked by misshapen skaabs and Gisa escapes in the chaos.
timeline.quote: we were overcome by a sudden attack of ghastly, violent, misshapen skaabs.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she has broken out of prison.
timeline.quote: GUESS WHO JUST BROKE OUT OF PRISON!

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa describes escaping her carriage and returning to the old family home in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: I swept my feet over my chains and rammed the door, escaping into the fog

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises her dead parents to apologize for the fire that destroyed the house.
timeline.quote: I raised Mummy and Father to apologize for what we did to the house.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf scolds Gisa for raising their parents and tells her not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: You are being incredibly irresponsible.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Grete tracks Gisa to the remains of an old manor in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: I have caught up with Gisa in Nephalia.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Grete observes ghouls calmly walking toward Gisa's whistled summons along the Nephalian coast.
timeline.quote: They simply walk toward their conductor.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa meets Nahiri, who cuts down her summoned ghouls and then becomes her friend.
timeline.quote: the woman unsheathed a tremendous sword and severed each of my ghouls on the spot.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
timeline.quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf reveals he sent the skaabs to free Gisa from the prison caravan.
timeline.quote: I was the one who sent the skaabs to free you from the prison caravan.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Grete withdraws toward Thraben as Gisa erupts in a violent rage.
timeline.quote: Departing immediately.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
timeline.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
timeline.quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: Do not contact me again.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa smashes porcelain in a tantrum in the cathedral, having secured Thraben by eliminating most of the living after Liliana's zombies took it.
timeline.quote: The plate shattered against the wall

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt, a risen ghoul with his own army, marches toward Thraben to win Gisa's love.
timeline.quote: At the head of his column of the dead, Wilhelt marched on Thraben

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
timeline.quote: I knew you were my inferior.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
timeline.quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa spots an army of the dead led by a rider approaching Thraben and runs to meet it, delighted to have something to do.
timeline.quote: Someone was riding along the road to Thraben.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt reaches the gates and declares himself to Gisa, who does not remember him and tries to whistle him into thralldom.
timeline.quote: Finally, tilting her head to the side, she asked, "Do I know you?"

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa's whistle tries to bind Wilhelt, but he resists and breaks her hold; Gisa retreats behind the gates.
timeline.quote: breaking the tie between them as Gisa's whistle died, choked off in her throat

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt breaks through the gates and his army is attacked by swarms of undead birds, then by the dead who surge out of the shops.
timeline.quote: They were halfway down the avenue when the dead surged out of the buildings to either side

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa urges Wilhelt to surrender; he refuses, so she leaves her soldiers to overwhelm his.
timeline.quote: Then she flounced away down the walk, not looking back

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt sends a ghoul with a love letter to Gisa, but she seizes the ghoul's mind and reads it.
timeline.quote: A single ghoul ran into the square

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa reads Wilhelt's letter, is offended that he implies she could get his name wrong, and resolves to destroy him.
timeline.quote: She resolved to destroy him.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa screams and all the bats in Thraben descend on Wilhelt's army, forcing him to flee.
timeline.quote: Then Gisa screamed, and all the bats in Thraben descended.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt vanishes from the battlefield, and Gisa decides to go to her brother.
timeline.quote: Wilham himself was gone.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
timeline.quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa by letter he wants nothing to do with her, then is horrified when she declares she will move in with him.
timeline.quote: Geralf wrote to his sister that he wanted nothing to do with her

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Two years after Emrakul's sealing, Gisa takes control of Liliana's abandoned zombie army and makes Thraben her own.
timeline.quote: Gisa took control of Liliana's abandoned zombie army and made Thraben her own

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa easily defeats the army of her suitor Wilhelt, forcing him to leave.
timeline.quote: Gisa easily defeated Wilhelt's army, forcing him to leave.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the battle Thraben lies in ruins; Gisa takes control of Liliana's zombies and rejects Wilhelt, who besieges the city and is defeated.
timeline.quote: Wilhelt then left Thraben, defeated.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf from the Engelturm, teasing him and mocking his skill as a ghoulcaller.
timeline.quote: What you do is no more than a pale imitation of my art

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
timeline.quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Bored at the Engelturm, Gisa watches Phyrexians shamble out of the Silburlind River.
timeline.quote: A small group of bipedal figures shambled out of the Silburlind River

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian cuts one of Gisa's ghouls in two with an oil-slick sword, and Gisa sends her dead to attack them.
timeline.quote: All around her, the dead she had risen for her own amusement turned toward the cluster on the shore.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa's ghouls destroy the group, but a Phyrexian corpse she raises collapses lifeless the moment her attention wanders; this has never happened to her before.
timeline.quote: This had never happened to her before.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa complains to Geralf that he has ruined the undead.
timeline.quote: You have ruined the undead. Do not do this again.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
timeline.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa proposes a united game of NecroWarfare against Phyrexia, with Havengul or the Engelturm as the prize, and Geralf accepts.
timeline.quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa draws in the death of Innistrad and calls a moondrake and ghouls from the estuary muck.
timeline.quote: the undead moondrake she had called from the muck rose, majestic, into the sky.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian moondrake rises, and Gisa's moondrake kills it in the air and on the ground, spoiling a Phyrexian plan.
timeline.quote: her drake ripped the other's head clean off

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A second Phyrexian force approaches overland past the Engelturm, and Gisa complains it is cheating.
timeline.quote: "I said three-way, not four-way,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Not to be outdone, Gisa sings up a colossal chitinous beast from the bottom of the estuary, and it wades into the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gisa's terrible new plaything rose from the bottom of the estuary

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians hack off the legs of Geralf's behemoth and then Gisa's sea-beast; both fall and Gisa stops laughing.
timeline.quote: Like the behemoth before it, it fell

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.
